01 — Profile

About me

I'm an Internet of Things graduate based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. I completed my B.Sc. at Kristu Jayanti University in July 2026 with a 7.42 CGPA. My interests sit at the intersection of IoT, cybersecurity, automation, and product design — I like understanding how technology works and how it can be turned into simple, useful, and intuitive experiences for people.

Alongside my degree, I've built several embedded IoT projects, completed a Cybersecurity-with-AI internship with Cisco Networking Academy, and an RPA internship with Daemon Education Technology. I've also picked up certifications across cloud security, virtualization, and machine learning, and led teams at two college hackathons that won at the college level. I'm currently looking for an entry-level opportunity where I can combine my technical background with my interests. Technical support, graduate trainee, analyst, trust & safety, and junior product/design opportunities are all of interest, and I'm open to relocating anywhere in India.
